title: Third-Order Cumulant Identification in a Three-Variable Cyclic Linear System with Dependent Errors
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=incremental < floor=field and projected paper_score_ceiling 6.1 < 7.4; not salvageable in scope without a new generic D!=0 theorem and headline re-anchor.
gap_reasons: The delivered identification theorem recovers (a,d) only on the sufficient chart D != 0, while the scope of that chart is established by one explicit witness and a local neighborhood rather than a genericity or broad-class result.
Consequently, the least-identifying-order theorem is confined to a nonempty regular intersection and does not establish a model-wide order-three frontier.
The fixed-motif scope, unquantified prevalence of the identifying chart, and lack of practical evidence keep the contribution below the field floor.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved the chart-conditional rational recovery of the outer coefficients, the legal order-two covariance fiber, the central-coefficient full-law fiber, and totalized uniform GMM/sandwich results. The field claim collapsed at novelty review because D != 0 was established only at an explicit witness and locally, leaving no generic or broad-class order-three frontier. A re-raised topic would need a legal five-source subclass and an open-dense or full-measure nonvanishing theorem for D, followed by a generic minimality headline.
tldr: In the three-variable linear system with overlapping feedback pairs and a path-dependent disturbance vector, endpoint independence generates three observable residual cross-cumulants. Covariance elimination turns the two third-order restrictions into observable cubics; for a mechanism \(m\), nonvanishing of the explicit chart \(D(P_m)=v(P_m)\chi(P_m)p_3(P_m)q_3(P_m)s_1(P_m)\) makes their linear first subresultant recover the observable functional \(\theta(P_m)=\theta(m)\), with the entire complex residual fiber equal to the structural truth. A legal one-dimensional real covariance fiber makes order three minimal on a nonempty regular locus, while a two-parameter middle-residual shear leaves the complete observed law unchanged and therefore keeps \((b,c)\) as sensitivity parameters. The statistical frontier is uniform feasible optimal-weight GMM and a uniformly covering sandwich ellipse over structural mechanisms \(m\in\mathfrak M_6\), indexed coherently by their induced laws \(P_m\) and targets \(\theta(m)\).
gap: Published dependent-error identification is complete for acyclic graphs but only partial for cycles, while existing higher-cumulant recovery assumes global source restrictions that exclude arbitrary middle-error dependence. Covariance nonidentification results do not establish the projected legal fiber required for an information-order lower bound, and nearby cumulant estimators provide pointwise rather than uniform inference.
fill: The project supplies a rational order-three inverse \(\theta(P_m)=\theta(m)\), a legal real order-two query-moving fiber, and a complete-law central shear, then targets a uniform centered-cumulant GMM expansion and sandwich coverage over a single compact mechanism class under transparent quantitative margins.
